data.title: Token Usage & Cost
data.tagline: The cumulative model tokens in a task and the price calculated from the model’s rate card
data.learningOutcome: You can separate token usage across a task from the cost calculated from a price sheet.
data.description: System rules, chat history, files, tool results, and model output all use tokens across a multi-turn task. Cost also depends on the model and separate input, output, and cached-token prices; external tools may have their own fees.

learning.assumes: You know that tokens are pieces of text a model processes.
learning.outcome: You can separate token usage across a task from the cost calculated from a price sheet.

explanation.title: Every turn has input
explanation.text: Rules, chat history, files, and tool results may enter the model again each turn.

explanation.title: Every turn has output
explanation.text: Responses, next-step suggestions, and tool requests also produce output tokens.

explanation.title: Calculate each token category separately
explanation.text: Add input, output, cache, and model categories, then apply the matching rates.

data.boundary: The same number of tokens can cost different amounts. Do not mix external-tool charges into token usage.

lessonPractice.title: An Agent resends long system rules, full chat, and tool results every round, and the bill keeps rising. How should cost be diagnosed and reduced?

options.label: Track input, output, cache, and model price per round, then remove irrelevant context
options.feedback: Multi-round cost follows actual processed content and rates, so itemized usage reveals repeated input and expensive stages.

options.label: Count only the user's new sentences and ignore system rules, history, and tool results
options.feedback: Everything the model reads each round contributes to usage; newly visible user text is only one part.

options.label: Hide old messages in the chat interface and assume request cost falls automatically
options.feedback: Display and request assembly are separate, so hidden messages may still be sent by the backend.

data.agentPrompt: Report each Agent round's input, output, cached tokens, model, and estimated cost, marking repeated history and large tool results. Remove irrelevant context before considering a cheaper model, and never count only new user text.
